scope: Selma° HyperCore PR #114 follow-on delivery queue
selection_policy: Source evidence/dependencies first; choose nonconflicting ready item; complete bounded work and hand off immediately within same activation when eligible. Maximum seven bounded operations per activation. No continuous background agent.

items.title: Review 25-check preflight load on a permitted local browser
items.acceptance: Verify 25 cards render and no runtime errors.

items.title: Exercise JSON import with real user-selected file
items.acceptance: Reject malformed/overlarge data without changing ledger.

items.title: Exercise summary export without excerpts
items.acceptance: Export contains counts and statuses, no raw evidence.

items.title: Check next-item focus and keyboard traversal
items.acceptance: Focus moves to first outstanding checkpoint.

items.title: Inspect 320px screen fit
items.acceptance: No horizontal scroll or clipped controls.

items.title: Inspect 360px screen fit
items.acceptance: Cards and controls fit without clipping.

items.title: Inspect 768px screen fit
items.acceptance: Responsive two-column layout is readable.

items.title: Inspect 1200px screen fit
items.acceptance: Cards and statistics align without overflow.

items.title: Check screen-reader semantics
items.acceptance: Controls and status messages have accessible names.

items.title: Measure contrast of text and status chips
items.acceptance: Record actual measured contrast results.

items.title: Verify reduced-motion preference
items.acceptance: Animation respects reduced-motion settings.

items.title: Validate same-origin storage read/refresh
items.acceptance: Updates to original ledger reflected without modification.

items.title: Threat-model user-controlled evidence imports
items.acceptance: Sensitive excerpts never sent or echoed; no script injection.

items.title: Instrument live browser for outbound requests
items.acceptance: No app-initiated external requests on local preflight.

items.title: Verify main ledger navigates to preflight
items.acceptance: Click opens correct local page, preserves source ledger.

items.title: Reconcile source commit fields against GitHub
items.acceptance: Separate entered SHA format from fetched commit authenticity.

items.title: Specify bounded read-only Codemagic evidence format
items.acceptance: Schema handles app/job IDs, exact SHA, timestamps and missing fields.

items.title: Implement opt-in local build metadata import
items.acceptance: No secret input, triggers or implicit server API request.

items.title: Classify lint/test report results separately
items.acceptance: Real fail outputs remain FAIL; no optimistic coercion.

items.title: Define APK filename/size receipt schema
items.acceptance: Preserve original artifact identity and exact source.

items.title: Implement user-selected APK SHA-256 with memory limits
items.acceptance: Hash actual selected bytes without upload and record digest only.

items.title: Compare selected APK hash with trusted receipt
items.acceptance: Mismatches explicitly FAIL; unchecked metadata not accepted.

items.title: Run owned-device Android 11+ install/smoke checklist
items.acceptance: Capture actual device model/version, install and launch results.

items.title: Independent privacy/accessibility/code review
items.acceptance: Document findings with evidence and current commit SHA.

items.title: Owner-gated integration/merge readiness review
items.acceptance: No merge or release until tests, approvals and APK/device evidence exist.
